scripts.dev: npm run mobile:export && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @bitsknl/api && npm run build --workspace @bitsknl/web
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @bitsknl/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @bitsknl/web
scripts.test:smoke: node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/module-smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/permission-smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/api-parity-check.mjs
scripts.mobile:export:android: npm --prefix apps/mobile exec -- expo export --platform android --output-dir dist-android
scripts.build:mobile: npm run mobile:export && npm run build
